plugins.name: mkit
plugins.description: Coding-workflow skills for Claude Code: commit, review, pr, finish, cleanup, setup, sandbox-audit, explain and recap, over a shared git-safety + Conventional Commits reference bundle, plus shorten for tightening text. Standalone; only sandbox-audit needs the optional mkit binary (brew install masterik/tap/mkit).

plugins.name: catppuccin
plugins.description: Catppuccin colors for the Claude desktop and mobile apps: Latte in light mode, Frappé, Macchiato or Mocha in dark, any of 14 accents. A theme mod from masterik/mk-mods, released on its own; /catppuccin switches.

plugins.name: vscode
plugins.description: VS Code's default 2026 colors for the Claude desktop and mobile apps: Light 2026 in light mode, Dark 2026 in dark. A theme mod from masterik/mk-mods, released on its own.
